top_signals.title: US Initial Jobless Claims Below 200,000 for Third Straight Week
top_signals.summary: Applications for US unemployment benefits edged up to 199,000 in the week ended Aug. 1, according to Labor Department data released Thursday. Claims remained below 200,000 for a third straight week and the four-week moving average fell to the lowest since September 2022. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
